free.title: OPEN STREETS COMES TO FOREST HILLS
free.caption:
FREE · FOREST HILLS

Forest Hills just closed a street to cars and nobody's talking about it yet. Austin Street between 71st Ave and 71st Rd goes fully car-free every Sunday through Sep 20, 10AM-5PM - sidewalk chalk, a kids' bike zone and local shops setting up tables right in the road.

It's a trial: Neighbors for a Safer Austin Street only secured a permit for four Sundays, so today's one of the last chances to see it before organizers decide whether it sticks around.

TIP: come by subway - 71 Ave or Austin St-Forest Hills (both E/F/M/R) drop you right on the block, no parking search needed.

Send this to someone who never made it out to Forest Hills.

📷 Photos via Pexels

food.title: SMORGASBURG MATSURI: JAPAN MEETS BROOKLYN
food.caption:
FOOD · PROSPECT PARK

Smorgasburg in Prospect Park goes full Japan today. Breeze Hill's usual food-market lineup gets joined by curated guest vendors for Japan Meets Brooklyn: Matsuri, 11AM-6PM, free to walk in.

Expect one-day-only specials from vendors who don't normally set up in Brooklyn, plus a limited-capacity omakase tasting tent and live cultural performances later in the afternoon.

TIP: the market is walk-up, but the sit-down omakase tent is limited-capacity - get there early if you want a seat, and enter near Lincoln Road for the shortest walk in.

Send this to whoever you'd drag to a food market on a Sunday.

📷 Photos via Pexels

art.title: 6 SECRETS OF CONEY ISLAND
art.caption:
HIDDEN GEM · CONEY ISLAND

Everyone's been to Coney Island. Almost nobody knows the Wonder Wheel is a genuinely rare “eccentric” design, or that the Cyclone wasn't even the first roller coaster there.

Six things that don't make the postcards: a switchback railway beat the Cyclone by 43 years, the Parachute Jump was originally built for the 1939 World's Fair in Queens, and Nathan's only exists because Nathan Handwerker quit his old boss to sell hot dogs cheaper.

TIP: the boardwalk and beach are free every day of the year - it's only the rides that cost anything, and the Wonder Wheel keeps running through October.

Send this to whoever thinks they've already seen everything here.

📷 Photos via Pexels
